::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 15th [1874]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 246-7
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
This is all very satisfactory, thank you much. One thing more. Should not there be a facsimile of the autograph[^1] - I should <u>like</u> a page of that exquisitely neat distinct writing which never altered from the time it formed itself at Eton - and which spreads into sheets upon sheets of mine and yet I never stumble at a word.

I must put in a page with a list of the islands arranged in their groups for reference. I can make one from the Reports. Most of the islands have two names native and discoverer’s, and a good many three native, English and Spanish - and as everybody is always varying the spelling of the native names one gets distracted

But I will make a list and get the [Bishop of Lichfield](people/person_1295.qmd) to correct it

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The letter is about the publication of the *Life of John Coleridge Patteson*.
